executionPolicy.antiLoopRule: Reject any new refinement, hardening or cleanup work unless it directly verifies a currently missing exit criterion or removes a named completion gate blocker.
executionPolicy.waveSuccessRule: A wave is productive only if it changes at least one exit criterion from MISSING to EVIDENCE_READY or VERIFIED, clears a named completion gate, integrates an exact-SHA candidate, emits a receipt, or advances to the next macrocycle.
executionPolicy.blockedProjectRule: A human or infrastructure gate blocks only the sensitive action; all other enabled projects must continue on their own active macrocycle.
executionPolicy.fanOutRule: Dispatch one closure work item per enabled project in every wave unless that project is already waiting solely on an external human gate.

active.title: Risultato, storico e progressione
active.selectionBasis: Recent verified delivery completed result publication and weekly planning, while durable history and progression remain the structural composition target.

closureWorkItem.objective: Implement and verify one authenticated durable result write/reopen path tied to exact plan and session version.
closureWorkItem.forbiddenWork: UI polish, refactors or unrelated workout features

exitCriteria.description: Workout result is stored durably and linked to the authenticated user and exact plan/session version.
History can be reopened after restart and displays completed, partial and safely stopped sessions.
Progression consumes persisted results rather than browser-local or query-only state.
Product CI, independent Robot QA and realistic end-to-end flow pass on the exact integrated SHA.

active.title: Database operativo, persistenza e audit foundation
active.selectionBasis: Current operator previews and read-only workspaces are verified, but the largest structural gap is real persistence, audit and reversible recovery.

closureWorkItem.objective: Stop product refinements and execute the existing exact-SHA candidate through Product CI, Robot R01-R03, independent review, integration and post-merge replay.
closureWorkItem.forbiddenWork: Any further SQLite hardening or generic test expansion not required by a failing closure gate

exitCriteria.description: A canonical operational database schema exists for at least products, stock movements, users and audit events.
A reversible migration creates the development/staging database without mutating EasyFarm or production data.
At least one real operator journey writes and reloads persistent state transactionally.
Every mutation produces an attributable immutable audit event.
Backup, rollback and recovery are tested in an isolated environment.
Delta Robot QA, full cumulative Robot simulation and post-merge replay pass on exact SHA before completion.

active.title: Upload reale e persistenza durevole
active.selectionBasis: Browser-local alpha journeys are extensive, while real upload and durable reopenable storage remain the main product bottleneck.

closureWorkItem.objective: Implement and verify one bounded authenticated upload that persists metadata and object reference across restart and a new session.
closureWorkItem.forbiddenWork: Gallery polish, local-only flows or unrelated media features

exitCriteria.description: An authenticated user can upload a bounded real photo into an isolated development environment.
Media metadata and object reference persist across restart and a new authenticated session.
Upload is idempotent and rejects malformed, oversized or unsupported content fail closed.
Delete and rollback behavior preserve consistency between metadata and object storage.
Product CI, independent Robot QA and a realistic upload-reopen journey pass on exact integrated SHA.

transitionRule: Activate the next productive macrocycle only after every exit criterion is VERIFIED and a completion receipt is persisted for the current macrocycle.
reconciliationRule: Before every wave, replace stale PR, SHA, integration and completion fields using live GitHub API evidence and commit ancestry. Operational comments are append-only evidence, never authoritative current state.
